developmentScope: Exactly four previously observed survivor inputs, no reserved selection or holdout World execution. Bot wins are not human acceptance.

limits: Exactly four previously observed survivor inputs; this is development evidence, not fresh holdout or human success rate.
All original native configs/full profile/7200 seconds/864000 steps/strategy/RNG streams preserved. Source changes can change realized later choices/rewards.
First6 complete StageSummary equality to native N is tested; whole-result hashes may differ.
Death-cancel observations are censored, with null latency. No release or interrupt is fabricated from a cancellation.
Interrupt channel is read from actual native cumulative damage/hit operands. Generic sidecar old thresholdCause text is superseded only by these explicit metadata snapshots.

Opened primary, selected, impact-time aimed target, damage-time cast confirmation, and countedPrimary are different fields. Auto/manual focus both allowed; manual flag does not establish human action.
Native role TTK and death-star/finite-credit cells describe defeated entities including approach/pre-fusion lifetime. Living entities are censored and low-star reinforcement mix affects pooled means.
Stage skill counters are preserved at stage granularity; no causal HP/shield attribution to a specific ward/volley cast is inferred.
Engineering guards passing is separate from sustained late challenge, browser acceptance or release adoption.

slamCapComparison.formula: endless depth>=4 ? min(original Math.round authored formula,player.stats.maxHp*0.45) : original Math.round authored formula
limits: Exactly4 observed development inputs; no fresh holdout success rate or release acceptance.
The cap is on single authored slam damage before original hurt/shield/invulnerability processing. It does not cap every damage source or guarantee aggregate1second damage is <=45%.
This uses maximum HP, not current HP; lethal outcomes are not dynamically prevented or relabelled.
Actual later realized builds can diverge after mechanics change; use native per-input facts rather than infer full equivalence from equal cast counts.
